flags.why: This verb belongs to formal speech and writing, so leaving it untagged misleads learners about casual usage ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/don-cu-epX8cyrd7lXrC.html)).
The entry omits the common literal meaning of taking or bringing someone or something out.
flags.fix: to take or bring out; ex: Anh ấy đưa ghế ra sân. = He brought the chair out into the yard.
